metrics.name: Contrast
metrics.description: Measures the luminance difference between text, icons, and their backgrounds against accessibility thresholds.

metrics.name: Visual Hierarchy
metrics.description: Measures how clearly size, weight, and emphasis signal what matters most and in what order.

metrics.name: White Space
metrics.description: Measures whether there is enough negative space around and between elements to let content breathe.

metrics.name: Alignment
metrics.description: Measures how consistently element edges and centers line up along shared axes.

metrics.name: Spacing Consistency
metrics.description: Measures whether gaps between elements follow a coherent, repeated spacing scale.

metrics.name: Grid Layout
metrics.description: Measures whether content is organized on a stable column and row structure that governs placement.

metrics.name: Typography
metrics.description: Measures the choice and coherence of typefaces, weights, and type scale.

metrics.name: Text Readability
metrics.description: Measures line length, line height, and paragraph sizing that make running text easy to read.

metrics.name: Color Palette
metrics.description: Measures whether color is restrained, purposeful, and used to convey meaning rather than decoration.

metrics.name: Consistency
metrics.description: Measures whether the same components, patterns, and terms behave and look the same throughout the product.

metrics.name: Affordances
metrics.description: Measures whether interactive elements look like what they do and non-interactive ones do not invite clicks.

metrics.name: Feedback and System Status
metrics.description: Measures whether the interface confirms user actions and reports the current system state promptly.

metrics.name: Navigation Clarity
metrics.description: Measures whether users can tell where they are, where they can go, and how to get back.

metrics.name: Information Architecture
metrics.description: Measures whether content is grouped, labeled, and structured in a logical way that matches user mental models.

metrics.name: Form Design
metrics.description: Measures the structure, labeling, grouping, and input choices of forms for efficient completion.

metrics.name: Error Prevention
metrics.description: Measures how well the design stops users from making mistakes through constraints, defaults, and confirmations.

metrics.name: Error Recovery
metrics.description: Measures how clearly errors are explained and how easily users can correct them and continue.

metrics.name: User Control and Freedom
metrics.description: Measures whether users can undo, cancel, back out of, and escape from actions and flows.

metrics.name: Keyboard Accessibility
metrics.description: Measures whether every function can be reached and operated using only a keyboard in a logical order.

metrics.name: Screen Reader Semantics
metrics.description: Measures whether markup and labels expose correct roles, names, and states to assistive technology.

metrics.name: Focus Visibility
metrics.description: Measures whether the currently focused element is clearly and consistently indicated.

metrics.name: Touch Target Size
metrics.description: Measures whether tappable and clickable targets are large enough and spaced to hit accurately.

metrics.name: Responsiveness
metrics.description: Measures whether layout and content adapt without breaking across screen sizes and orientations.

metrics.name: Perceived Performance
metrics.description: Measures how fast the interface feels to respond, independent of measured load times.

metrics.name: Loading and Empty States
metrics.description: Measures whether loading, empty, and no-results states are designed to inform and guide rather than leave users stranded.

metrics.name: Motion
metrics.description: Measures whether animation is purposeful, brief, and respectful of reduced-motion preferences.

metrics.name: Iconography
metrics.description: Measures whether icons are recognizable, consistent in style, and paired with labels where meaning is ambiguous.

metrics.name: Copy and Microcopy
metrics.description: Measures whether labels, hints, buttons, and messages are clear, concise, and action-oriented.

metrics.name: Cognitive Load
metrics.description: Measures how much mental effort the screen demands by limiting simultaneous decisions and information.

metrics.name: Interaction Cost
metrics.description: Measures the number of steps, clicks, and decisions needed to complete common tasks.

metrics.name: Recognition over Recall
metrics.description: Measures whether users can see options and cues rather than having to remember them.

metrics.name: Progressive Disclosure
metrics.description: Measures whether advanced or rarely needed content is revealed only when it is wanted.

metrics.name: Platform Conventions
metrics.description: Measures whether the interface follows the standard behaviors and idioms users expect on its platform.

metrics.name: Trust and Credibility
metrics.description: Measures whether the visual quality, details, and signals make the product feel reliable and legitimate.

metrics.name: Data Density
metrics.description: Measures whether the amount of information shown per area suits the task without becoming cluttered or sparse.

metrics.name: Theme Parity
metrics.description: Measures whether light, dark, and other themes preserve the same legibility, hierarchy, and meaning.

metrics.name: Localization Readiness
metrics.description: Measures whether the layout and components tolerate longer text, right-to-left scripts, and varied date and number formats.
